articles.description: Table containing article metadata and content.

columns.name: published_date
columns.description: The date when the article was published in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

columns.name: article_category
columns.description: The category of the article. Valid values: 'technology', 'business', 'sports', 'travel', 'health', 'entertainment', 'politics', 'fashion'.

columns.name: content_word_count
columns.description: The word count of the article's content.

columns.name: full_content
columns.description: The full text content of the article.
